data.name: Daliya
data.gender_notes: Daliya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘dalila’, meaning ‘guide’ or ‘light’. In Islam, Daliya symbolizes the divine guidance and illumination that leads to spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Daliya carries the meaning “Sunlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daliya usually hope their child will grow to embody sunlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Daliya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sunlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daliya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
